title: Nicolette (Niki) van der Poel
text: As a recent UCSB graduate from a double major in Environmental Studies and Global Studies, I have spent a great deal of my education focused on both human and environmental interests. I am interested in blending the two so that nature and humans can co-exist. GIS, Statistics, and Environmentally Protected Areas give unique opportunities to explore this intersection whether through sustainable development, natural disaster mitigation, planning for sea level rise, or collaboratively managing environmentally protected areas.
